label: Дело
description: A 10-sentence usage card for дело (matter; business).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative as predicate. 'Дело' is a neuter noun in the nominative as the predicate noun. 'Важное' agrees in the neuter, and 'очень' intensifies the importance.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Дело' is the neuter accusative direct object of 'закончил', matching the nominative form. 'Трудное' agrees in the neuter accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Дело' is nominative here, but 'ума' is genitive in the set phrase meaning none of my business. A natural idiom for declining to judge.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after 'много'. 'Дел' is the bare-stem genitive plural of 'дело', required after 'много'. A high-frequency way to say you are busy.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'к'. 'К делу' uses the dative 'делу' after 'к' to mean approaching the matter. 'Серьёзно' is an adverb of manner.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'с'. 'С делом' uses the instrumental 'делом' after 'с' in a set phrase contrasting words and deeds. 'Слова' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'занят'. 'Делом' is the instrumental governed by the short adjective 'занят'. 'Важным' agrees in the neuter instrumental.

missions.phrase: В этом деле нет ничего сложного.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В деле' uses the prepositional 'деле' after 'в' to mean in this matter. 'Этом' agrees in the neuter prepositional.

missions.phrase: У него всегда много важных дел.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive plural after 'много'. 'Дел' is again the genitive plural of 'дело'. 'Важных' agrees in the genitive plural, describing his many tasks.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'О делах' uses the prepositional plural 'делах' after 'о' to name the topic. 'Наших' agrees in the plural prepositional.
